subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Diodes: One-Way Valves for Current
description: A micro-lesson that makes Diodes: One-Way Valves for Current usable.

hook.text: A diode lets current flow one direction and blocks it the other way.

buildup.text: It's a semiconductor junction — P-type meets N-type silicon.

discovery.text: Forward-biased, current flows freely. Reverse-biased, almost nothing passes.

twist.text: LEDs are diodes that emit light. The color depends on the semiconductor material.

climax.text: Rectifiers use diodes to convert AC to DC — inside every phone charger.

punchline.text: A diode is a one-way street for electrons.

quiz.question: What is the primary function of a diode?
options: To amplify weak signals into strong ones
To allow current in one direction and block it in the other
To store energy in a magnetic field
